stories.title: Art Gallery of Ontario to open 5-floor expansion in September 2027
stories.summary: The Toronto museum says the Dani Reiss Modern and Contemporary Gallery will display nearly 400 artworks by Indigenous, Canadian and international artists.

stories.title: Honda Canada to retool Alliston, Ont. plant for expanded hybrid production
stories.summary: Honda Canada says it will retool its manufacturing facilities in Alliston, Ont., to expand production of hybrid-electric and gasoline-powered vehicles.

stories.title: ‘Absolutely disgusting’: Ford addresses Hamilton poppy drive assault
stories.summary: An assault that left an air cadet captain with life-altering injuries last week was “absolutely disgusting,” Premier Doug Ford says.

stories.title: 17 arrested, 55 charges laid in OPP child sexual exploitation investigation
stories.summary: Seventeen people are facing a total of 55 charges in connection to a “proactive” child sexual exploitation investigation across Ontario.

stories.title: OSAP pause may force dental college to close, school says
stories.summary: A spokesperson said evidence of systemic issues left the government with no choice but to pause OSAP payments to all private institutions to ensure the integrity of the system.

stories.title: York University investigating cybersecurity incident, data theft
stories.summary: York University is investigating a cybersecurity incident resulting in the theft of personal data which was discovered last month.

stories.title: Hellebuyck, Meier lead Devils past Maple Leafs 4-0
stories.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 23 saves for his first shutout with New Jersey as the Devils blanked the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-0 on Sunday night.

stories.title: Toronto police identify city’s 33rd homicide victim in shooting
stories.summary: Emergency officials performed life-saving measures and transported the teenager to hospital, but he was pronounced dead after arrival.

stories.title: Toronto Pearson, Durham region ER among possible measles exposure sites
stories.summary: Known contacts in the Durham Region have been contacted by the department, but officials are issuing the warning after determining there may have been further exposures.

stories.title: McKenna gets benched, scores in latest Leafs’ loss
stories.summary: Gavin McKenna had the puck on his stick, looking to make a play in the offensive zone with the Maple Leafs already in a hole.
